references.text: Describes the same utensils for the altar: buckets, fire pans, bowls, forks, and censers that were made for the bronze altar of burnt offering.
Repeats the list of the altar's utensils: buckets, fire pans, bowls, forks, and censers, which were made of bronze.
The same pattern for covering with taḥash skins and inserting carrying poles is used for the ark of the covenant.
Parallel instruction to insert carrying poles after covering, here for the table of showbread.
Similar procedure with taḥash skins and carrying poles for the golden altar and the vessels of the sanctuary.
Mentions fire pans (maḥtot) as utensils used in the sanctuary service.
The censer (maḥtah) is used by the high priest on the Day of Atonement to carry burning coals.
Mentions carrying fire and utensils in connection with sacrifice, an early parallel to the altar's service.
